message: No detected input validation: The code only checks file existence (os.path.isfile) before loading; there are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only; no remote sources (URLs, S3, HuggingFace, etc.) are used, so no integrity verification or authentication is present.

No detected label flipping detection: The code transforms labels arithmetically (e.g., computing absolute complement) but never validates label distributions, checks for unexpected label values, or uses any label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation pipeline loads, normalizes, and patches data without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads data files (MAT/HDF5) and imports network modules but performs no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision checks on any pretrained weights or serialized models.
No detected label distribution validation: The code loads and reshapes labels but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or FGSM/PGD routines are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While X_train and X_test are separated, there is no signing/hashing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads data from files and performs basic file existence checks, but does no shape, range, or schema validation on inputs before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model outputs (e.g., probability bounds, NaN guards, or threshold validation) are visible in any of the inference-path functions shown.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a medical imaging CNN pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
